entries.text: Keeper, you hear me? Storm's right on top of you. Keep that light burning till dawn. Lose the light, or let the water take the tower, and we're all done for.
entries.transcription: Keeper, you hear me? Storms right on top of you. Keep that line burning till dawn. Lose the light or let the water take this tower and we're all done for.
flags: Over 10 s; retained at natural speed

entries.text: Fix tonight's jobs. Sleep upstairs when they're done.
entries.transcription: Thanks tonight's jobs. Sleep upstairs when they're done.

entries.text: Three nights. Keep the light burning and the water down. Bring every ship home.
entries.transcription: Three nights. Keep the light burning and the water down. Bring every ship home.

entries.text: There's a pipe giving out downstairs. Grab the wrench off the bench.
entries.transcription: There's a pipe giving out downstairs. Grab the wrench off the bench.

entries.text: Hold grip to take the wrench. Bring its head to the bolt, then pull toward you.
entries.transcription: Hold grip to take the wrench. Bring its head to the bolt, then pull towards you.

entries.text: Hold grip. Bring it to the bolt and pull toward you. Push back, pull again.
entries.transcription: Hold grip, bring it to the bolt and pull toward you. Push back, pull again.

entries.text: Leave the wrench, keeper. Follow the lamps to your next job.
entries.transcription: Leave the wrench keeper. Follow the lamps to your next job.

entries.text: We saw your light last night. Another front's coming in. Generator's down again.
entries.transcription: We saw your light last night. Another front's coming in. Generator's down again.

entries.text: Generator's dead. Read the plate on the side. Prime it, choke it, pull.
entries.transcription: Generator's dead. Read the plate on the side. Prime it. Choke it. Pull.

entries.text: Fuel's running low. Line up the lantern and send the storm warning.
entries.transcription: Fuel is running low. Line up the lantern and send the storm warning.

entries.text: Still with us, keeper? Check the board. It's going to be a long one.
entries.transcription: Still with us, Keeper? Check the board. It's gonna be a long one.

entries.text: The pipe needs you. Take the wrench downstairs.
entries.transcription: The pipe needs you. Take the wrench downstairs.

entries.text: Next, the generator. Follow the lamps upstairs.
entries.transcription: Next, the generator. Follow the lamps upstairs.

entries.text: Head to the radio. Send the storm warning.
entries.transcription: Head to the radio. Send the storm warning.

entries.text: Up to the lantern, keeper. Light it and line up the marks.
entries.transcription: Up to the lantern keeper, light it and line up the marks.

entries.text: Check the breakers beside the generator.
entries.transcription: Check the breakers beside the generator.

entries.text: Jobs done. Grip your bunk upstairs.
entries.transcription: Job's done. Grip your bunk upstairs.

entries.text: Follow the hiss, keeper. Wrench on the bolt. Pull.
entries.transcription: Follow the his keeper, wrench on the bolt, pull.

entries.text: The plate on the generator. Fuel, prime three, choke, pull three, choke down.
entries.transcription: the plate on the generator, fuel, prime, three times, choke, pull three times, choke down.

entries.text: Check the breakers. You can't run everything at once.
entries.transcription: Check the breakers. You can't run everything at once.

entries.text: Get up to the lantern. Light it, then turn the wheel till the marks line up.
entries.transcription: Get up to the lantern, light it, then turn the wheel till the marks line up.

entries.text: Four steps on the radio. Power, tune, code, then hold the mic.
entries.transcription: Four steps on the radio. Power and tune, code and hold the mic.

entries.text: Work's done. Bunk's on the third floor.
entries.transcription: Work's done. Bunk's on the third floor.

entries.text: Not yet. There's still work to do.
entries.transcription: Not yet. There's still work to do.

entries.text: That'll do it.
entries.transcription: That'll do it.

entries.text: There she goes.
entries.transcription: There she goes.

entries.text: Light's burning.
entries.transcription: Lights burning.

entries.text: That'll hold. Get to your bunk, keeper. You'll need it.
entries.transcription: That'll hold. Get to your bug keeper. You'll need it.

entries.text: We see your light, keeper. Every ship made it through. Get some rest.
entries.transcription: We see you at Lightkeeper. Every ship made it through. Get some rest.

entries.selectionReason: Original says the first line, then 'That's thirty. Again, thirty.' Keep the second complete attempt.

entries.text: Pipe's gone again, keeper. Get the wrench on it before the water climbs.
entries.transcription: pipe's gone again keeper get the wrench on it before the water climbs

entries.text: Power's back. Now get that lantern lined up and send the storm warning.
entries.transcription: Power's back! Now get that lantern aligned and send the storm warning.

entries.text: Set the wrench down, keeper. You won't need it up there.
entries.transcription: Set the wrench down, keeper. You won't need it up there.

entries.text: Take a breath, keeper. The storm's waiting on you, but not for long.
entries.transcription: Take a breath, keeper. The storm's waiting on you, but not for long.

entries.text: Tonight it's the pipe and the generator. Pipe first.
entries.transcription: Tonight, it's just the pipe and the generator. Pipe first.

entries.text: Tonight it's everything, keeper. Pipe, power, lantern and the radio.
entries.transcription: Tonight is everything, Keeper. Pipe, power, lantern, end the radio.

entries.text: One of you hold that valve. The other, get on the bolt.
entries.transcription: One of you hold that valve, the other get on the boat.

entries.text: Set the clamp on the valve, then work the bolt.
entries.selectionReason: Full-memo ASR labels this number 79; surrounding ordered numbers and the clamp sentence identify script line 69.
entries.transcription: Set the clamp on the valve, then work the bolt.

entries.text: Grab a handset off the bench. You'll hear each other across the floors.
entries.transcription: Grab a handset off the bench. You'll hear each other across the floors.

entries.text: Quickest way down is the pole. Grip it and slide.
entries.transcription: Quickest way down is the pull. Grip it and slide.

entries.text: Breaker's tripped. Too much on the line.
entries.transcription: Break is tripped. Too much on the line.

entries.text: Fuel's low. Top up that tank before she dies.
entries.transcription: Fuel is low. Top of the tank before she dies.

entries.text: She's stalled. Start her up again.
entries.transcription: She stalled. Start her up again.

entries.text: The lens is fouled with soot. Wipe it clean.
entries.transcription: The lens is fouled with soot. Wipe it clean.

entries.text: That's not it. Try the code again.
entries.transcription: That's not it. Try the code again.

entries.text: Copy, keeper. Warning's out. Good work.
entries.transcription: Copy keeper, warnings out. Good work.

entries.text: That was close, keeper. Too close.
entries.transcription: That was close, keeper. Too close.

entries.text: Fourth night. The sea's angrier than I've ever heard it. Everything's going to go at once.
entries.transcription: Fourth night sees anger than I've ever heard it. Everything's going to go at once.

entries.text: Last night, keeper. This is the big one. Hold on till dawn and the boat comes for you.
entries.transcription: Last night, keeper, this is the big one. Hold on till dawn and the boat comes for you.

entries.text: She's through. You did it, keeper.
entries.transcription: She's through. You did it, keeper.

entries.text: Boat's coming for you at first light. You held the light, keeper. All five nights.
entries.transcription: Boats coming for you at first light. You held a light keeper all five nights.

entries.text: Water's at your knees, keeper.
entries.transcription: Waters at your knees, keeper.

entries.text: It's reaching the generator!
entries.transcription: It's reaching the generator!

entries.text: You're going under, keeper!
entries.transcription: You're going under, Keeper!

entries.text: Your light's out. There are ships out there!
entries.transcription: Your light's out! There's ships out there!

entries.text: Thirty seconds, keeper!
entries.transcription: 30 seconds, keeper!

entries.text: Ten seconds!
entries.transcription: TEN SECONDS!

entries.text: Valve slipped! Hold it steady!
entries.transcription: Valve slipped! Hold it steady!

entries.text: Ship on the horizon! Keep that light steady.
entries.transcription: Ship on the horizon, keep that light steady.

entries.text: She's close to the rocks. Don't you let that light go out.
entries.transcription: She's close to the rocks! Don't you let that light go out!

entries.text: Your partner's in trouble. Get to them!
entries.transcription: Your partner's in trouble. Get to them.

entries.text: Oh no... she's on the rocks.
entries.transcription: Oh no! She's on the rocks!

entries.text: Keeper? Keeper, do you read? ...Keeper?
entries.transcription: Keeper. Keeper, do you read? Keeper.
